newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end down on talk of cut in MOF/BOJ JGB buying.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end down on talk of cut in MOF/BOJ JGB buying.

text.p: *JGB futures end lower on vague rumour, later denied, that MOF may reduce or even halt outright bond purchases. *Also rumour that BOJ may reduce outright bond buying. BOJ officials were not immediately available for comment. *Investors' bargain-hunting interest remained intact.
